name: cli-health
description: Single source of truth for the cli-health CLI command surface. Schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1; cross-validated against each domain's Connect-RPC proto descriptor at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest. New RPCs must either land here as a command binding or be listed in `omitted[]` with a reason.

groups.name: validate
groups.description: Run cli-health validators against a scenario's CLI manifest, proto, and endpoints.json

commands.name: scenario
commands.description: Validate a single scenario by id

groups.name: search
groups.description: Search CLI commands across scenarios (AI-first with text fallback)

commands.name: query
commands.description: Search the indexed corpus by natural-language text

flags.name: mode
flags.description: Force a retrieval mode: ai | text (default lets the server choose)

commands.name: status
commands.description: Report search backend availability (ollama, qdrant, indexed count)

groups.name: command
groups.description: Validate Vrooli-owned command references without executing them

flags.description: Validation policy: docs | skill | plan | action

flags.name: qualifiers
